original:
Let $\Sigma$ be a connected signed graph with at least two vertices whose negative edges are incident to a common vertex.
If $\Sigma$ has a balanced block, then there is a connected ordinary graph $G$ on $|V(\Sigma)|$ vertices such that $P_{G}(q)=Z_{\Sigma}(q)$ .
type: ∀ (n : ℕ) (P N : SimpleGraph (Fin n)), 2 ≤ n → (P ⊔ N).Connected → (∃ u, ∀ (v w : Fin n), N.Adj v w → v = u ∨ w = u) → Mathlib2.x2611_16458_hasBalancedBlock P N → ∃ G, G.Connected ∧ Mathlib2.x2611_16458_zeroFree G ⊥ = Mathlib2.x2611_16458_zeroFree P N

lemma x2611_16458_prop3_2_aux1 {V W : Type*}
    (G : SimpleGraph V) (H : SimpleGraph W) (f : V → W)
    (hf : ∀ v w, G.Adj v w → H.Reachable (f v) (f w))
    {v w : V} (h : G.Reachable v w) : H.Reachable (f v) (f w) := by
  obtain ⟨p⟩ := h
  induction p with
  | nil => exact SimpleGraph.Reachable.rfl
  | cons h p ih => exact (hf _ _ h).trans ih

lemma x2611_16458_prop3_2_aux2 {V : Type*} [Finite V] (u : V) :
    Nat.card (Bool ⊕ {v : V // v ≠ u}) = Nat.card V + 1 := by
  classical
  letI := Fintype.ofFinite V
  have hpos : 0 < Fintype.card V := Fintype.card_pos_iff.mpr ⟨u⟩
  simp only [Nat.card_eq_fintype_card, Fintype.card_sum, Fintype.card_bool,
    Fintype.card_subtype_compl, Fintype.card_subtype_eq]
  omega

lemma x2611_16458_prop3_2_aux3 {V : Type*} (P N : SimpleGraph V) (u : V)
    (hconn : (P ⊔ N).Connected)
    (hneg : ∀ v w, N.Adj v w → v = u ∨ w = u) :
    (x2611_16458_split P N u).Connected := by
  classical
  let H := x2611_16458_split P N u
  let f : V → Bool ⊕ {v : V // v ≠ u} :=
    fun v => if h : v = u then Sum.inl true else Sum.inr ⟨v, h⟩
  have hst : H.Adj (Sum.inl true) (Sum.inl false) := by
    simp [H, x2611_16458_split, SimpleGraph.fromRel_adj]
  have hedge : ∀ v w, (P ⊔ N).Adj v w → H.Reachable (f v) (f w) := by
    intro v w hvw
    by_cases hv : v = u
    · subst v
      have hw : w ≠ u := hvw.ne.symm
      simp only [f, dif_pos rfl, dif_neg hw]
      rcases hvw with hp | hn
      · apply SimpleGraph.Adj.reachable
        simp [H, x2611_16458_split, SimpleGraph.fromRel_adj, hp]
      · apply hst.reachable.trans
        apply SimpleGraph.Adj.reachable
        simp [H, x2611_16458_split, SimpleGraph.fromRel_adj, hn]
    · by_cases hw : w = u
      · subst w
        simp only [f, dif_neg hv, dif_pos rfl]
        apply SimpleGraph.Reachable.symm
        rcases hvw.symm with hp | hn
        · apply SimpleGraph.Adj.reachable
          simp [H, x2611_16458_split, SimpleGraph.fromRel_adj, hp]
        · apply hst.reachable.trans
          apply SimpleGraph.Adj.reachable
          simp [H, x2611_16458_split, SimpleGraph.fromRel_adj, hn]
      · simp only [f, dif_neg hv, dif_neg hw]
        rcases hvw with hp | hn
        · apply SimpleGraph.Adj.reachable
          simp only [H, x2611_16458_split, SimpleGraph.fromRel_adj]
          exact ⟨fun he => hp.ne (congrArg (fun z => z.val) (Sum.inr.inj he)), Or.inl hp⟩
        · exact (hneg v w hn).elim (fun he => (hv he).elim) (fun he => (hw he).elim)
  have hr : ∀ v, H.Reachable (Sum.inl true) (f v) := by
    intro v
    simpa only [f, dif_pos rfl] using
      (x2611_16458_prop3_2_aux1 (P ⊔ N) H f hedge (hconn u v))
  apply (SimpleGraph.connected_iff_exists_forall_reachable H).mpr
  refine ⟨Sum.inl true, ?_⟩
  intro a
  rcases a with s | v
  · cases s
    · exact hst.reachable
    · exact SimpleGraph.Reachable.rfl
  · simpa only [f, dif_neg v.property] using hr v.val

-- This is the existing split-polynomial identity from Proposition 2.3 /
-- Corollary 2.5, so the forge can reuse that already tracked dependency.
lemma x2611_16458_prop3_2_aux4 :
    ∀ {V : Type*} [Finite V] (P N : SimpleGraph V) (u : V),
      (∀ v w, N.Adj v w → v = u ∨ w = u) →
      x2611_16458_zeroFree (x2611_16458_split P N u) ⊥ =
        (Polynomial.X - 1) * x2611_16458_zeroFree P N := by
  sorry

-- A balanced block is attached to the rest of the split graph at a single
-- vertex. If it contains the balancing vertex, balance forces every edge
-- from that vertex inside the block to have the same sign, since deleting
-- the vertex leaves the block connected. This gives a cut vertex upstairs.
lemma x2611_16458_prop3_2_aux5 :
    ∀ {V : Type*} [Finite V] (P N : SimpleGraph V) (u : V),
      (∀ v w, N.Adj v w → v = u ∨ w = u) →
      x2611_16458_hasBalancedBlock P N →
      ∃ a : Bool ⊕ {v : V // v ≠ u},
        ¬ ((x2611_16458_split P N u).induce {b | b ≠ a}).Connected := by
  sorry

-- Choose neighbors a,b of a cut vertex c in different components of H-c.
-- Identify a with b. This glues the two sides along the edge ca=cb, so the
-- chromatic polynomial is divided by X-1. Relabel its n vertices by Fin n.
lemma x2611_16458_prop3_2_aux6 :
    ∀ {V : Type*} [Finite V] (n : ℕ) (H : SimpleGraph V),
      2 ≤ n → Nat.card V = n + 1 → H.Connected →
      (∃ a : V, ¬ (H.induce {b | b ≠ a}).Connected) →
      ∃ G : SimpleGraph (Fin n), G.Connected ∧
        x2611_16458_zeroFree H ⊥ =
          (Polynomial.X - 1) * x2611_16458_zeroFree G ⊥ := by
  sorry

theorem x2611_16458_prop3_2 (n : ℕ) (P N : SimpleGraph (Fin n)) (hn : 2 ≤ n)
    (hconn : (P ⊔ N).Connected)
    (hneg : ∃ u : Fin n, ∀ v w, N.Adj v w → v = u ∨ w = u)
    (hblocks : x2611_16458_hasBalancedBlock P N) :
    ∃ G : SimpleGraph (Fin n), G.Connected ∧
      x2611_16458_zeroFree G ⊥ = x2611_16458_zeroFree P N := by
  obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := hneg
  have hcard : Nat.card (Bool ⊕ {v : Fin n // v ≠ u}) = n + 1 := by
    simpa using x2611_16458_prop3_2_aux2 u
  obtain ⟨G, hG, heq⟩ := x2611_16458_prop3_2_aux6 n
    (x2611_16458_split P N u) hn hcard
    (x2611_16458_prop3_2_aux3 P N u hconn hu)
    (x2611_16458_prop3_2_aux5 P N u hu hblocks)
  refine ⟨G, hG, ?_⟩
  have hX : (Polynomial.X - 1 : Polynomial ℤ) ≠ 0 := by
    simpa using Polynomial.X_sub_C_ne_zero (1 : ℤ)
  exact mul_left_cancel₀ hX
    (heq.symm.trans (x2611_16458_prop3_2_aux4 P N u hu))
